modules.title: 项目规则怎样影响 Agent 的代码生成

items.title: 一份规则文件包含约定与禁止项
items.text: 典型的 AGENTS.md 或 .cursorrules 包含：(1) 项目概述与技术栈；(2) 文件结构与风格约定；(3) 禁止行为（如私自提交代码、删除数据库）；(4) 验收方式。建议先写 5-10 条最容易踩坑的规则。

items.title: 自动成为多轮任务的上下文
items.text: 工具读取项目规则后，模型会把它们带入当前任务，减少每次重复说明要求。

items.title: 规则可随仓库共享，但绝不能放密钥
items.text: 团队规则通常随 Git 提交；真实 API 密钥和个人绝对路径不应写进规则文件，密钥应交给环境变量。

modules.title: 项目规则不能代替硬性检查
modules.text: 项目规则是给 Agent 的指导，不是客户端权限策略，也不会像编译器、Linter 或测试那样自动证明结果正确。敏感操作仍要由权限边界控制，修改结果仍要用项目已有检查和人工判断验收。

lessonPractice.title: AI 总是生成不符合团队技术栈的代码，哪种做法最直接？

options.label: 在项目规则文件中写明技术栈、代码风格和高风险操作确认要求
options.feedback: 对。项目规则会作为任务上下文提供给 Agent，帮助它在生成阶段遵循团队约定。

options.label: 把代码风格规则写进只控制 Provider 和端口的客户端配置文件
options.feedback: 客户端配置控制工具怎么连接和运行，不能代替给 Agent 的项目开发规范。

options.label: 只增加编译或 Linter 检查，就能在生成前告诉 AI 应该怎么写
options.feedback: 编译器和 Linter 主要在生成后发现问题，不能替代项目规则在生成阶段提供指导。

en.title: The AI keeps generating code outside the team's stack. What is the most direct fix?

options.label: Put the stack, code style, and risky-action approval rules in project instructions
options.feedback: Correct. Project rules enter the agent's task context and guide generation toward the team's conventions.

options.label: Put code style rules in the client config that only controls the Provider and port
options.feedback: Client config controls how the tool connects and runs; it does not replace project guidance for the agent.

options.label: Only add compiler or linter checks and they will tell the AI how to write code before generation
options.feedback: Compilers and linters mainly catch problems after generation; they do not replace guidance during generation.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请先读取项目根目录的规则文件，再修改按钮组件。遵循既有技术栈，不使用 any；删除或重置前先说明命令并等待确认，改完运行项目已有检查。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Read the project rules before editing the button component. Follow the existing stack, do not use any, and ask before delete or reset commands. Run the project's existing checks after editing.

learning.assumes: You collaborate with an AI agent on code inside a project.
learning.outcome: You can put stable stack and approval rules in project instructions and distinguish them from client config and system prompts.

modules.title: How do project rules affect an agent's code generation?

items.title: Rules files contain conventions and constraints
items.text: A typical AGENTS.md or .cursorrules includes: (1) project overview and tech stack; (2) code conventions and structure; (3) forbidden actions (e.g. no committing, deleting DBs); (4) verification steps. Starting with 5–10 high-value rules works best.

items.title: Become part of the multi-turn context
items.text: Tools read project rules and pass them to the model automatically, reducing repetitive prompting.

items.title: Share rules with the repo, but never secrets
items.text: Team rules are committed to Git; real API keys and local paths belong in environment variables, not rules files.

modules.title: Project rules do not replace hard checks
modules.text: Project rules guide the agent; they are not a client permission policy and do not prove correctness like a compiler, linter, or test. Keep sensitive actions inside permission boundaries, then verify changes with the project's checks and human judgment.

distinctions.label: System Prompt
distinctions.text: A {c:system-prompt} shapes the model's fundamental persona and reasoning guidelines; {c:project-rules} define repository-specific engineering conventions and workflow constraints.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: Read the project rules before editing the button component. Follow the existing stack, do not use any, and ask before delete or reset commands. Run the project's existing checks after editing.
